MasterAdmin._comment: Only used once, on first startup, if no MasterAdmin exists in the DB yet. Change the email/password here BEFORE running the API for the first time, or better: move it to 'dotnet user-secrets' and delete it from this file.

Internal._comment: Shared secret trusted internal clients (uberworks-webapp, later Mobile) send as 'X-Internal-Secret' when calling endpoints that have no caller JWT yet (see POST /api/users/external-login). Keep the real value only in 'dotnet user-secrets' on both the API and the WebApp — never here.

WebApp._comment: Used to build the password reset link that goes in the email (see UserService.ForgotPasswordAsync) — must point at wherever uberworks-webapp is actually running.

Smtp._comment: Left blank on purpose: until these are filled in (here or, better, in 'dotnet user-secrets'), SmtpEmailSender.cs just logs the email instead of sending it — the forgot-password flow still works end-to-end for testing, the reset link just shows up in the console/log instead of an inbox.
